text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: PrBoom is a source port of id Software's Doom engine designed to run Doom, Doom II, and compatible games on modern hardware. It preserves the original gameplay while adding improvements such as higher resolutions, improved compatibility, and additional features. Source ports like PrBoom helped maintain Doom's active community by supporting custom levels, modifications, and fan-created content long after the original release.
